metadata.question: Did Vietnam have more active fire detections than Myanmar on February 3, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need to use MODIS fire detection data (MCD64A1 or MODIS_6_FIRMS) for both Vietnam and Myanmar on February 3, 2018. MODIS Active Fire data provides daily fire detection counts. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed; fire detection data is already processed and gives fire presence/absence. I'll count active fire pixels in each country's geometry. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - If collections are empty (no images on that date), output C1. - If valid pixels after filtering = 0, that's a valid result (no fires detected), so answer B (or A if the other location had none too). - If the result is NaN or None, output C3. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Vietnam and Myanmar const vietnam = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([102.145, 8.6, 109.646, 23.393]); const myanmar = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([92.172, 9.16, 101.869, 28.547]); // 2. Define target date const targetDate = '2018-02-03'; const startDate = '2018-02-03'; const endDate = '2018-02-04'; // 3. Acquire MODIS Active Fire data (FIRMS) const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const fireCollectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`FIRMS Images on ${targetDate}: ${fireCollectionSize}`); if (fireCollectionSize === 0) { console.log('No fire data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Count active fire detections in each region const fireImage = fireCollection.first(); // Get fire count for Vietnam const vietnamFireCount = fireImage .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), vietnam, 1000, 1e9 ) .values() .get(0) .getInfo(); // Get fire count for Myanmar const myanmarFireCount = fireImage .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), myanmar, 1000, 1e9 ) .values() .get(0) .getInfo(); console.log(`Vietnam Fire Detections: ${vietnamFireCount}`); console.log(`Myanmar Fire Detections: ${myanmarFireCount}`); // 5. Validation & Answer if (vietnamFireCount === null || myanmarFireCount === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (vietnamFireCount > myanmarFireCount) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
